memory_bridge: Give the sun-aged person two roles: in a white coat the person is 医者 for On シャ, while without a title the person is 者 for Kun もの.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 医者（いしゃ）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Dress the sun-aged person in a white coat and introduce an 医者（いしゃ）; the final character sounds On シャ in “doctor.”

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 者（もの）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Remove the coat and point simply to the person as 者（もの）; the standalone native noun fixes Kun もの, “person.”
